species: To establish this model, male C57BL/6 J mice, aged 6–8 weeks, weighing approximately 20 g, were treated with 14 Gy abdominal irradiation (ABI) or sham IR.
tissue: To verify whether this circRNA would respond to IR in intestinal tissue, we tested its expression level in mice jejunum at a different time after 14 Gy ABI.
cell_type: Primarily expressed in intestinal stem cells, CircDmbt1(3,4,5,6) was downregulated in mice intestines after 14 Gy abdominal radiation and showed timely relationship with intestinal injury level.
disease_state: The intestine is one of the most sensitive organs to ionizing radiation (IR), and radiation-induced intestinal injury (RIII) impacts the quality of life of patients undergoing radiotherapy.
sample_source: Crypts were extracted from a healthy mouse for protein extraction, and circDmbt1(3,4,5,6)-overexpressing 293 T cells were used for RNA extraction.
age: To establish this model, male C57BL/6 J mice, aged 6–8 weeks, weighing approximately 20 g, were treated with 14 Gy abdominal irradiation (ABI) or sham IR.
cell_line: Murine intestinal epithelial cell line MODE-K (ZKCC62328) was purchased from Otwo Biotech Co. Ltd. Murine intestinal epithelial cell line CT26 (1101MOU-PUMC000275) and rat intestinal epithelial cell line IEC-6 (1101RAT-PUMC000110) were obtained from the Cell Resource Center, Peking Union Medical College (PCRC). The 293 T (CRL-3216) cell line was purchased from American Type Culture Collection (ATCC).
